purpose: Material and construction styling only. OBJ meshes and contract.json override all pictured proportions.

materials.wood: Warm honey brown broad planks; darker recesses; restrained grain; broad cel-shaded highlights.
materials.iron: Dark desaturated forged iron straps with sparse large fasteners; restrained highlights.
materials.edges: Readable bevels away from locked interfaces. Keep mating edges planar.

image_review.accepted: Color, surface treatment, flush wall tops, open wall ends, one gunport per side, flat decks.
do_not_copy: Image wall aspect ratios and separation do not match the metric blockouts.
Image stair opening has a near-end crosspiece: omit it. The contracted first slot tile is open at both longitudinal ends.
The apparent deep hatch lining is not a floor-thickness specification. Floor thickness remains 0.18 m.
F_STAIR_PORT_PAIR is a concept label, not a new part. Assemble F_STAIR_PORT and F_STAIR_PORT_END.
Use exactly thirteen stair treads from A_STAIRS_260, not a count inferred from the picture.

modeling_constraints: Preserve connection vertices within 0.001 m and protected 0.10 m interface zones.
Do not extend posts, trim or iron across stacking planes.
Keep stair slots, gunports and landing clearances open.
Apply style to the existing fifteen meshes rather than reconstructing dimensions from this sheet.
